title: Supercuspidal Datum for a Covering Group
body_html:
Supercuspidal Datum for a Covering Group

Let \(\widetilde G\to G\) be a central \(\mathbb C^\times\)-covering group occurring in a type I dual pair. A supercuspidal datum for \(\widetilde G\) is \[ \widetilde\Sigma=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho,\xi), \] where \((x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho)\) is a supercuspidal datum for \(G\) and \[ \xi:K\to \widetilde K \] is a splitting of the cover over the compact subgroup \(K\), agreeing on \(K_{0+}\) with the canonical pro-unipotent splitting coming from the generalized lattice model.

The splitting identifies \(\widetilde K\) with \(K\times\mathbb C^\times\). The genuine \(K\)-type and compact induction attached to this datum are recorded separately in supercuspidal_theta.covering_attached_representation.
